nodes.text: Human Metapneumovirus has been detected in India. While it shares symptoms with COVID-19, experts emphasize that HMPV isn’t new and has been circulating for decades. Learn about its symptoms, risks, treatments, and whether we should be worried about widespread infections. https://t.co/FAldCeorra
